code:
import pandas as pd

def feature(history):
    col = "smart_9_raw"
    h = history.sort_values("date")
    last = h.groupby("serial_number", group_keys=False).tail(1)
    out = pd.Series(index=last["serial_number"].astype(str), dtype=float)
    for model, grp in last.groupby("model"):
        idx = grp["serial_number"].astype(str)
        s = grp[col].astype(float)
        out.loc[idx] = s.rank(pct=True).to_numpy()
    return out
